title: Lewis structures
log: 2026-11-01T08:04:32Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: Neither bank point teaches drawing Lewis diagrams of bonding pairs and lone pairs of valence electrons; covalent bonding covers electron sharing in general and the shapes point covers electron-pair repulsion and molecular shape, so both are related but not the same idea.

draft.title: Lewis structures
card: A Lewis structure shows the valence electrons of a molecule. Each line is a bonding pair shared between two atoms. Each pair of dots is a lone pair on one atom.
To draw one, count the total valence electrons from all atoms. Join the atoms with single bonds, then place lone pairs so that each atom has a full outer shell.
Hydrogen is full with 2 electrons. Carbon, nitrogen, oxygen and fluorine are full with 8, shown as bonding pairs plus lone pairs.
Some atoms share more than one pair. A double bond is two shared pairs and a triple bond is three. Count each bonding pair once for the atom at each end.
draft.remember: Lines are shared pairs, dots are lone pairs, and each atom ends up with a full outer shell.

a.q: In the Lewis structure of ammonia, NH3, how many lone pairs are on the nitrogen atom?
a.why: Nitrogen has 5 valence electrons. Three are shared in N-H bonds, so 2 electrons remain as 1 lone pair. That gives 3 bonding pairs plus 1 lone pair, which is 8 electrons. Zero is tempting, but it would leave nitrogen with only 6.
a.clue: Nitrogen needs 8 electrons around it, and 6 are in bonds.

b.q: A chemist draws the Lewis structure of water, H2O. Which description is correct?
opts: Two O-H bonds and two lone pairs on oxygen
Two O-H bonds and one lone pair on oxygen
Two O-H bonds and no lone pairs on oxygen
Two O-H bonds and two lone pairs on each hydrogen
b.why: Oxygen has 6 valence electrons. Two are shared in bonds, leaving 4 electrons as 2 lone pairs, so oxygen has 8 around it. Hydrogen is full with its one bonding pair, so it has no lone pairs.
b.clue: Oxygen has 6 valence electrons and uses 2 in bonds.

b.best: Two O-H bonds and two lone pairs on oxygen
